palette.mood: Midnight indigo cab interior. Clicky is a gunmetal counter (#8C93A3) lit by sodium amber (#FF9A1F) as LIGHT only, an electric teal stream (#00E0C6), bone courtroom paper (#EDE6D3) only in shots 8 and 9, and signal magenta (#E0338A) on ALLEGED stamps, the NOT ENROLLED sign and the NO ADMISSION stamp. Curious, dry, fair, never alarmist.
palette.divergence: Against 11-01 (storm slate #2E3B45, sulphur key, golden lantern), 10-31 (cream paper, cobalt sea, brass, vermilion) and 10-29 (aubergine dusk, gold): this film is midnight indigo (#1A1740 sky, #262252 ground, #0B0A1F shadow) with gunmetal rather than brass, an amber that is LIGHT and never an object color, electric teal and magenta. The nearest value is 11-01's dark slate, resolved by moving every dark to the indigo hue family.
palette.accent_licence: magenta ONLY on the ALLEGED stamps, the NOT ENROLLED sign and the NO ADMISSION stamp. Teal ONLY on the data stream, the ring pulses and the gate bolts and thread. Amber ONLY as light (dash glow, passing streetlamp sweeps), never a fill on an object. Bone paper ONLY in shots 8 and 9, plus the one paper-flip transition in shot 10.

shape_language.grammar: DISCRETE against CONTINUOUS: the every-three-seconds pings are hard staccato dots and rings firing off Clicky, against one long hinged gate bar that moves exactly once, and an edgeless teal stream that only gets edges when it meets the gate
shape_language.why: The alleged surveillance is a constant tick, the settlement is a single decisive hinge. The picture of the turn is the stream meeting a gate with a seat. Shots 4 and 10 show the contrast at full strength.

composition.focal_hierarchy: Clicky and the fob first, plates second

composition.safe_area: Hero action inside y420 to 1500, captions in the open band
composition.signature_shot: Shot 10, beat key 25 at 88.6s: the gate lever slams from COLLECT BY DEFAULT to ASK FIRST. The teal stream hits the closed gate and pools, Clicky stops clicking for the first time and its rings die, a single sodium sweep crosses the frame. Camera track-follow along the stream resolving to a lock at zoom 1.0 from the slam to the end of the shot.
